_about: Where to turn off a company's emails when its messages carry no List-Unsubscribe header. Only entries checked on the company's own help pages; 'checked_on' is the date. Steps are paraphrased from the help page.

steps: Log in on the web and open Settings (the more-options icon, bottom left).
Open Notifications in the left menu.
Expand 'How you get notifications' and switch off Email, then Save.
Pinterest says the change can take a day or two.
